messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] high error rate and latency spike for inference.redwood-prod.az1a - error_rate 8.7% (5m), p50 45ms -> 220ms, affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Pager: maria (oncall) has been paged.

maria (oncall): Ack. Looking.

maria (oncall): I'm seeing NLB target health flaps and increased retransmits on host i-0abc1234... started ~2026-03-17T13:14Z. Can someone check AZ network plane?

ben (infra): Jumping in. I see kernel tx_skb_queue drops on g5 instances in az1a. syslog snippet: `NETDEV WATCHDOG: eth0: transmit queue 0 timed out`.

jess (sre): Confirmed elevated 502s and GRPC stream resets. Autoscaler hasn't spun new nodes; ephemeral pool at ~92% utilization.

maria (oncall): Quick plan: 1) Shift new request traffic to eu-west-1 (70%), 2) Disable streaming on affected routes, 3) Drain problematic targets. Ben start drains, Kevin prep customer comms.

ben (infra): Starting drain for i-0abc1234 and i-0def5678 via ASG detach. Updating traffic-router: `rbctl route set inference-prod --region-weight az1a=30,eu-west-1=70`.

ben (infra): Ran `kubectl cordon` + `kubectl drain` for pods on those nodes. Kernel trace shows DMA/NIC errors on host. Opening AWS ticket INC-281234.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation to infra (level 2) — ticket INC-281234 created by ben.

kevin (support): Drafting initial customer note: "We've detected a regional network impairment impacting US-west inference. Traffic is being rerouted to reduce errors; we're monitoring and will update in 30m." Will share to CSMs.

jess (sre): Any recent control-plane or routing pushes this morning? Deploy logs show no config changes. Seems hardware/network.

maria (oncall): No pushes from infra team either. Ben to AWS: request NIC replacement and route shift. Also enable cache priming to reduce load: `/admin/cache/prime inference-prod --prefix-cache 1h`.

ben (infra): AWS acknowledges host NIC flapping on an aggregate. ETA ~35-45m for replacement. Spinning emergency capacity: 4 reserved instances in eu-west, 1 in us-east.

kevin (support): Sent initial comm to enterprise CSMs. Included mitigation steps and that we routed traffic to eu-west for new requests. :email:

maria (oncall): Monitoring: error_rate down ~5% since shift; p50 on failover path ~120ms. Still seeing retransmits on residual az1a targets. Continue draining.

jess (sre): Applied mitigation: `streaming=false` on /v1/chat in ring 2 to reduce long-lived connections. Patch applied.

ben (infra): Completed drains for 8 targets. 2 nodes had stuck connections; AWS recommends replacement over reboot. Replacement scheduled.

incident-bot: Oncall handoff scheduled: maria handing to jess in 45m.

maria (oncall): Handoff summary: traffic now routed 70% eu-west / 30% az1a; 8 targets drained, 2 nodes pending replacement (AWS INC-281234); customer comms sent. Next update in 30m. Paging jess for takeover.

jess (sre): I'll take over. Suppressing noisy 5xx alerts and documenting runbook steps in INC-281234.

kevin (support): I'll follow up with affected customers individually with remediation details and ETA for full recovery.

maria (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving notes in the incident doc and incident tracker. If AWS confirms hardware replacement and NIC stabilizes, we'll gradually shift traffic back and re-enable streaming.

maria (oncall): End."
